HomeNodeInfo.title: HomeNodeInfo
HomeNodeInfo.description: Represents the real-time signaling, telemetry, and discovery state of a user's Home Node Server.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated user who owns this Home Node.

deviceName.description: Human-readable model and manufacturer name of the Home Node phone.

ipAddress.description: Local IPv4 address of the Home Node on the Wi-Fi LAN.

port.description: Port number where NanoHTTPD local file and media streaming server listens.

isOnline.description: Whether the Home Node HTTP server is currently online and reachable.

secretToken.description: Random session UUID token required in x-auth-token header for all HTTP requests.

batteryLevel.description: Current battery percentage (0-100) of the Home Node phone.

freeStorageBytes.description: Available free storage bytes on the Home Node device.

totalStorageBytes.description: Total storage capacity in bytes on the Home Node device.

lastUpdated.description: Epoch milliseconds of the last status heartbeat.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the Home Node record was first initialized (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest signaling update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/home_node/{nodeId}.description: Per-user Home Node signaling and discovery state document (e.g., nodeId = 'main').
